incident.rootCause: prepare_candidate invoked candidate ordivon-host-mcp --check without an explicit --state-root, so candidate schema-v5 HostStorage opened the default /var/lib/ordivon/host authority and performed v4-to-v5 migration during candidate construction

liveAuthorityDisposition.reason: source fix is committed and verified before any recovery of the accidentally migrated live authority; live recovery is a separate quiesced operation

productLaw: Candidate construction / validation must be authority-pure; build-time self-checks may validate executable behavior but must not observe, migrate, or mutate production authority.
